conversation.message: How have you been feeling lately, overall?
I guess I have been feeling pretty tired lately. I wake up in the middle of the night and can't go back to sleep.
How long has it been since you've felt rested after waking up?
Months, maybe? It feels like I've been running on empty for a long time.
Is it harder to focus or concentrate than it used to be?
Yeah. I get distracted easily. I'll be in a meeting and suddenly I'm thinking about something else.
How often does that happen during meetings?
It happens a lot, to be honest. I try to stay engaged, but my mind starts to wander.
How have you been sleeping lately?
Not well. I wake up a lot, and I usually don't fall back asleep until morning.
How many times would you say you're waking up in a typical night?
Maybe five or six times? I don't know, it feels like a lot.
Been doing anything you enjoy lately?
Not really. I used to like hiking, but I haven't done that in a while. I just don't have the energy for it lately.
How long has it felt like you've been without that energy?
I guess a year? Maybe longer. It just feels like things have been draining me for a long time.
When you think about the next few weeks, what do you expect day to day?
I don't know. I guess I just hope I can get through it without falling asleep at my desk.
What makes you worry about falling asleep at your desk?
Because I could miss something important. Or I could just fall asleep and... I don't know. It's a risk, I guess.
Do you find it harder to make decisions than before, even small ones?
Yeah. Sometimes I just can't decide what to eat for lunch. It feels like everything takes a lot more effort than it used to.
How long has it felt like even small choices take that extra effort?
Months, maybe? I used to be able to make a decision and move on. Now it feels like I'm constantly tired.
Do you feel like you have enough energy for your usual day?
No. I feel like I'm running on empty by lunchtime.
What do you usually do when you feel that way in the afternoon?
I usually just sit there and stare at my screen. I don't have the energy to do much of anything.
Are you still into the things you used to care about?
Not really. I used to love playing guitar, but I haven't picked it up in months. I just don't have the energy for it lately.
What else has felt harder to find the energy for?
Just everything, I guess. Cooking, cleaning... I used to do all that stuff easily, but now it takes so much effort.
Is there anything weighing on your mind that you wish you could change?
Yeah. There are a lot of things. I just wish I could go back to how things were before.
What was different about how things were before?
I guess I was just happier. I didn't feel so tired all the time.
How do you feel about how things have gone for you recently?
I don't know. I guess I just feel sorry for myself a lot.
What kinds of things make you feel sorry for yourself?
Just everything. I look at my friends who have kids, or who have jobs they like, and I just feel like I lost my way.
How's your appetite been?
Not great. I skip meals a lot. I guess I just don't have the energy for food.
How long have you been feeling too tired to eat?
Months, maybe? I used to love cooking, but now I just don't care.
Have you found yourself getting emotional more easily lately?
Yeah. I cry a lot lately. I don't know why, it just happens.
